g.title: A10
g.text: A10 — Vision extraction and evidence fusion

g.title: fail
g.text: hard prerequisite or required live-stage failure

g.title: fullpage
g.text: each fetched page becomes one segment

g.title: empty_store
g.text: no eligible patent records or structures

g.title: abstain
g.text: successful no-page / no-crop or no resolved structure

g.title: result_gate
g.text: Valid fixed structure + confidence available / above floor

g.title: record
g.text: family lineage + patent term + legal status

g.title: index
g.text: rebuilt from completed report + patent records

g.title: receipts
g.text: audit metadata; reused by evidence assembly

g.title: bind_review
g.text: Bind prompt hashes + exact claim/source spans

g.title: review_brief
g.text: SHA-256 binds brief + full private map + prompt hashes

g.title: stop
g.text: Stop before clearance metadata and output
